literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Foundations of epistemic vs aleatoric uncertainty and subjective probability.
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Philosophical and mathematical foundation for Dirichlet vacuity $u = K/S$.
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: Requires deterministic numerical realization in $<2	ext{ ms}$.
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: Knightian Uncertainty $\to$ Distinguishes risk from unmeasurable uncertainty $\to$ Non-algorithmic $\to$ Cannot run on edge $\to$ Resolved by Dirichlet evidential neural parametrizations in P22.

literature_dimensions.citation: Blundell et al. (ICML 2015) 'Weight Uncertainty in Neural Networks' / Neal (1995)
literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Places probability distributions over network weights via variational inference (Bayes by Backprop).
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Gold standard theoretical benchmark for epistemic uncertainty.
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: Requires sampling $N \ge 20$ weight configurations during inference.
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: Multi-pass sampling incurs $>30	ext{ ms}$ latency, violating edge $5	ext{ ms}$ SLA.
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: BNNs $\to$ Sound weight distributions $\to$ Monte Carlo weight sampling $\to$ Prohibitive edge compute $\to$ Unresolved single-pass gap $\to$ P22 uses single-pass Dirichlet output parametrization.

literature_dimensions.citation: Gal & Ghahramani (ICML 2016) 'Dropout as a Bayesian Approximation'
literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Interprets test-time dropout as approximate variational inference over network topologies.
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Practical baseline for measuring predictive variance.
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: Requires $10\text{--}30$ stochastic forward passes per camera frame.
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: Scales inference time linearly by factor of $10\times\text{--}30\times$ ($28.5	ext{ ms}$).
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: MC-Dropout $\to$ Approximates BNN without retraining $\to$ Stochastic multi-pass execution $\to$ Incompatible with real-time video $\to$ P22 derives analytical single-pass variance bound $\mathrm{Var}(p_k) \le \frac{1}{4(S+1)}$.

literature_dimensions.citation: Lakshminarayanan et al. (NeurIPS 2017) 'Simple and Scalable Predictive Uncertainty Estimation'
literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Trains $M$ randomly initialized models and aggregates predictions to capture epistemic diversity.
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Empirical state-of-the-art for OOD detection and calibration.
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: Requires $M\times$ memory storage and $M\times$ FLOPs ($18.2	ext{ ms}$ for $M=5$).
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: Exceeds SRAM/UMA cache limits on embedded edge systems.
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: Deep Ensembles $\to$ High empirical OOD accuracy $\to$ $5\times$ memory and compute footprint $\to$ Violates edge resource envelope $\to$ P22 achieves AUROC 1.0 with a single network backbone.

literature_dimensions.citation: Sensoy et al. (NeurIPS 2018) 'Evidential Deep Learning to Quantify Classification Uncertainty'
literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Formulates classification as Subjective Logic Dirichlet belief assignment over class logits.
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Core mathematical basis for P22 evidential uncertainty mass.
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: EDL provides the loss formulation but lacks formal variance bounds and optical blur coupling.
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: Must be integrated with sensor quality gating to prevent blur-induced false confidence.
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: EDL $\to$ Single-pass Dirichlet parametrization $\to$ Vulnerable to optical blurs producing non-zero evidence $\to$ Missing physical signal verification $\to$ P22 derives Theorem 1 variance bounds and couples EDL with frequency-domain blur gating.

literature_dimensions.citation: Malinin & Gales (NeurIPS 2018) 'Predictive Uncertainty Estimation via Prior Networks'
literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Separates data uncertainty (aleatoric) from distributional uncertainty (epistemic) using Dirichlet priors.
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Theoretical justification for treating vacuity $u = K/S$ as distributional shift indicator.
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: Requires out-of-distribution training data during training phase.
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: OOD distributions cannot be exhaustively anticipated at deployment time.
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: Prior Networks $\to$ Formal separation of aleatoric vs epistemic risk $\to$ Relies on synthetic OOD training sets $\to$ Open-world edge shifts remain unseen $\to$ P22 utilizes multi-branch disagreement and blur metrics as zero-shot safety firewalls.

literature_dimensions.citation: Guo et al. (ICML 2017) 'On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks' / Platt (1999)
literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Demonstrates overconfidence in modern deep nets and introduces single-parameter Temperature Scaling.
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Directly used in P22 to reduce ECE from $0.4218$ to $0.0412$ ($-90.2\%$).
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: Temperature scaling is monotonic; it changes calibration but does not alter rank-order or OOD separation.
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: Zero latency overhead ($<0.01	ext{ ms}$), ideal for edge inference.
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: Temperature Scaling $\to$ Optimizes ECE on in-distribution data $\to$ Does not fix OOD overconfidence $\to$ Uncalibrated inputs still pass $\to$ P22 couples Temperature Scaling with evidential vacuity gating.

literature_dimensions.citation: Hendrycks & Gimpel (ICLR 2017) MSP / Liang et al. (ICLR 2018) ODIN
literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Establishes baseline OOD detection via softmax scoring and input temperature perturbations.
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Direct comparative baseline in Table I and Table II.
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: MSP AUROC degrades to $\sim 0.78$ under realistic corruptions; ODIN requires backpropagation per frame.
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: Test-time gradient backpropagation is prohibited on edge video streams.
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: ODIN/MSP $\to$ Baseline OOD scoring $\to$ Low accuracy or backward pass requirement $\to$ Edge pipeline stall $\to$ P22 achieves AUROC 1.0000 forward-only in $1.486	ext{ ms}$.

literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Maps logit vectors to Helmholtz free energy $E(\mathbf{x}; T) = -T \cdot \ln \sum \exp(z_k / T)$ for OOD scoring.
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: Energy values are unbounded and sensitive to arbitrary logit scale shifts across sensor gain changes.
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: Thresholds must be retuned for differing environmental lighting.
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: Energy OOD $\to$ Bypasses softmax normalization $\to$ Unbounded score requires retuning $\to$ Vulnerable to edge gain variations $\to$ P22 uses strictly bounded Dirichlet vacuity $u \in [0, 1]$.

literature_dimensions.citation: Pech-Pacheco et al. (ICPR 2000) / Pertuz et al. (Pattern Recognit. 2013) / Dodge & Karam (2016)
literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Modified Laplacian Energy and Fourier high-frequency spectral ratios for passive focus/blur detection.
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Mathematical foundation for optical blur score $B(I)$ in Section 3.3.
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: Detects blur but is completely agnostic to semantic out-of-distribution shifts.
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: Extremely fast $2\text{D}$ spatial convolution ($<0.35	ext{ ms}$).
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: Laplacian/Fourier Filtering $\to$ Quantifies optical modulation transfer $\to$ Semantic blindness $\to$ Ineffective against clean adversarial/OOD inputs $\to$ P22 unifies blur with evidential Dirichlet uncertainty into composite $R_p$.

literature_dimensions.citation: Baltrusaitis et al. (TPAMI 2018) / Khaleghi et al. (Information Fusion 2013)
literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Measures consensus/discrepancy between heterogeneous feature extraction branches.
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Basis for multi-branch cross-agreement metric $d(\mathbf{x})$ in Section 3.4.
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: High overhead if both branches are heavy deep networks.
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: ScholarMaster pairs a primary lightweight extractor with zero-shot validation.
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: Multi-Branch Discrepancy $\to$ Identifies model-specific blindspots $\to$ High compute $\to$ P22 uses asynchronous zero-shot verification to maintain sub-$1.7	ext{ ms}$ latency.

literature_dimensions.citation: Sandler et al. (CVPR 2018) MobileNetV2 / Howard et al. (ICCV 2019) MobileNetV3
literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Defines edge-optimized depthwise separable architectures and strict latency budgets ($<5	ext{ ms}$).
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Establishes the hardware performance target ($30\text{--}60	ext{ FPS}$ edge video pipeline).
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: Optimized for speed at the cost of vulnerability to corrupted sensory inputs.
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: Integrity checking overhead must not exceed $20\%$ of frame budget.
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: Edge Backbones $\to$ High throughput ($>500	ext{ FPS}$) $\to$ Severe accuracy collapse under noise $\to$ P22 adds a $1.486	ext{ ms}$ fail-closed perception firewall.

literature_dimensions.citation: Seshia et al. (CACM 2022) 'Toward Verified Artificial Intelligence' / Leveson (1995)
literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Establishes formal contracts, environment assumptions, and fail-safe quarantine mechanisms.
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Governance and architectural philosophy underpinning fail-closed quarantine ($\bot$).
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: Formal methods typically target control logic rather than continuous sensory feature manifolds.
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: Verified AI $\to$ Formal safety contracts $\to$ Difficult to apply to deep neural weights $\to$ P22 proves analytic Dirichlet variance bounds and enforces runtime fail-closed invariants.

literature_dimensions.citation: Sambasivan et al. (CHI 2021) 'Data Cascades in High-Stakes AI' / Sculley et al. (NeurIPS 2015)
literature_dimensions.conceptual_contribution: Documents that $92\%$ of real-world AI failures stem from upstream data corruptions compounding across pipeline stages.
literature_dimensions.relationship_to_p22: Primary scientific motivation for isolating and containing errors at Layer 1.
literature_dimensions.limitation_for_p22: Empirical and qualitative diagnosis without mathematical prevention mechanisms.
literature_dimensions.edge_constraint: Prevention must occur at frame ingestion before memory allocation in Layer 2/3.
literature_dimensions.scholarly_chain: Data Cascades $\to$ Identifies systemic failure compounding $\to$ Lacks proactive mitigation $\to$ P22 proves and implements Layer-1 Fail-Closed Gating to achieve $\text{EAF} = 0.0000$.
